messages:
maya: Heads-up — PR #9124 (infra: reduce session cache) is blocked on CI flakes. Locally everything passes but the e2e keeps timing out. Can we get a rerun or a rebase window before the upcoming freeze?

arjun: which test is flaky?

maya: `tests/e2e/session_timeout.py` — timeout at ~302s intermittently. Fails only on linux-amd64 pool.

ci-bot: Build 1798501103 for PR 9124: FAILURE — flaky-test-suite (timeout)
  - failed jobs: e2e/session_timeout
  - logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/builds/1798501103
  Rerun available. Requested by @maya.

sophie: Reminder: deploy freeze starts 2026-03-24 00:00 UTC (infra rollout). Last merge cutoff is 2026-03-23 18:00 UTC. Anything large should land before that.

release-manager: If it's a single flaky test we can either force rerun or schedule a rebase slot pre-freeze. Which do you prefer?

maya: Prefer trying 2 quick reruns today. If it still flakes, request a rebase slot. PR is small and low-risk but we shouldn't change CI behavior during the freeze.

lee: I can review/approve quickly. If tests keep flaking and QA gives signoff I can approve a manual merge, but prefer the rerun first.

arjun: Plan: 1) 2 reruns now; 2) if still failing, label `needs-rebase-window` and ask @release-manager for a slot Tue morning (2026-03-24 09:00 UTC).

maya: kicking off rerun #1 now. tagging @lee for review.

ci-bot: Rerun 1798501114 queued by maya.

ci-bot: Rerun 1798501120 finished: SMOKE PASSED, e2e/session_timeout FAILED (timeout 302).

maya: damn — looks consistent this time. I'll capture a minimized repro and logs.

sophie: If you can narrow the repro we can triage marking it flaky. That would allow the PR to land before freeze but needs test-owner + QA ok.

release-manager: Who owns the flaky test? We should ping them.

arjun: I think @qa-team owns e2e session tests. @release-manager can you flag for QA?

lee: alternatively, if QA gives explicit signoff and there's a reviewer + one more approval, I will approve a manual merge and we can follow up with a fix post-freeze. Only if we have clear logs and a plan.

maya: adding logs and a short analysis to the PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/9124 — attaching `ci.log` and reduced run steps. Also pinged #help for QA.

ci-bot: Comment added to PR by maya with link to build: https://ci.redwood/internal/builds/1798501103

sophie: @release-manager — can we reserve a rebase slot if reruns fail again? We should avoid last-minute rush during freeze.

release-manager: Noted. If not merged by 2026-03-23 18:00 UTC this PR will be scheduled for the next rebase window on 2026-03-30 09:00 UTC. I can allocate a Tue morning 09:00 slot if you request it formally.

arjun: Ok. For now: two reruns, QA pinged, lee will hold on manual approval if QA signs off. If still flaky after reruns we open a rebase-window request.

maya: thanks — rerun #2 kicked.

ci-bot: Rerun 1798501159 finished: e2e/session_timeout FAILED (timeout).

maya: confirmed. Opening rebase window request now and adding label `needs-rebase-window`.

release-manager: Received request. I've provisionally assigned Tue 2026-03-24 09:00 UTC for PR 9124 if you need it. Please include a short mitigation plan in the request (how you'll validate post-merge).

lee: I'll stand by to do the manual approval if QA signs off and we document the flake + mitigation.

maya: added mitigation note and repro steps in PR. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

sophie: Good coordination — keep the timeline updated in the PR and drop a note here if anything changes.

ci-bot: Reminder: merge queue hold set for PR 9124 (label applied by maya).
